issues.guidedQuestion: What plans, registered instruments, ownership information, consents, and other materials must accompany the application?
issues.answerFragment: The application shall include copies of any other existing plans showing the boundary, and if reasonably available, the field notes and surveyor reports for those plans; copies of all registered instruments in the Province relating to the boundary location and required by the Registrar General; any requested abstract of title; a list of names, mailing addresses, interests, and interest descriptions for current owners of the parcel and parcels sharing the boundary; any obtained consent, waiver of notice, and agreement to be bound; and any other helpful or requested information or documentation.
